commit 81f4fcbfd098e9e6f27bd881cdd5641e088a0d30
author: idolgoff
date: 2026-07-16T22:04:02+03:00

    FININT-160: add OTP channel selection (SMS/Telegram) for Split TFA flow
    
    - Add channel field to YandexSplitInitConfirmationRequest and pass it in split client
    - Add SPLIT_TFA_DEFAULT_OTP_CHANNEL_BY_COUNTRY config (per-country, no HotSetting fallback)
    - Add GetSplitTfaDefaultOtpChannelAction to read channel from config
    - Add confirm_method to InitTFAParams, CommandSplitRetryInitChallenge
    - Add otp_channel to SplitTFAData, ResultSplitSubmitTFARequired, SplitTFAParams
    - Add confirm_method/otp_channel to TransactionEvent data classes
    - Wire channel selection in BaseSplitBnplFramelessProcessing.init_tfa
    - Propagate otp_channel through InitTFAAction, ApplyEvent{,Separated}Action
    - Expose otp_channel in SplitTFAParams API schema via get_view

+    async def _get_confirm_method(self) -> str | None:
+        if self.transaction_operation_id is None:
+            return None
+        try:
+            event = await self.storage.transaction_event.find_by_transaction_operation_id_and_event_type(
+                transaction_operation_id=self.transaction_operation_id,
+                event_type=TransactionEventType.INIT_REQUIRED,
+            )
+        except TransactionEvent.DoesNotExist:
+            return None
+        if not isinstance(event.data, TransactionEventInitRequiredData):
+            return None
+        return event.data.confirm_method
+

+from typing import Optional
+
+from pay.lib.entities.enums import Country
+
+from billing.yandex_pay_plus.yandex_pay_plus.conf import settings
+from billing.yandex_pay_plus.yandex_pay_plus.core.actions.base import BaseAction
+
+
+class GetSplitTfaDefaultOtpChannelAction(BaseAction):
+    def __init__(self, country: Optional[Country] = None):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.country = country
+
+    async def handle(self) -> Optional[str]:
+        country_code = self.country.value if self.country else None
+        if country_code:
+            override = settings.SPLIT_TFA_DEFAULT_OTP_CHANNEL_BY_COUNTRY.get(country_code)
+            if override is not None:
+                return override
+        return None
